args.subject: Summary of the client meeting
args.body:
Dear John,

I hope this message finds you well. Below is a brief summary of our recent meeting held on May 5, 2024:

- We discussed your requirements for the new project and agreed on the project timeline and key milestones.
- The initial design concepts were reviewed, and we gathered your valuable feedback.

Action Items:
- I will update the project plan based on your feedback.
- David will coordinate with the development team to start the initial phase.

Our next meeting is scheduled for June 1, 2024.

Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or further feedback.

Best regards,

Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
